# CultureMonkey

> CultureMonkey is an AI-powered employee engagement and feedback platform that helps organizations measure engagement, collect anonymous feedback, and drive workplace culture improvements through People Science Technology.

CultureMonkey provides comprehensive survey software and employee experience tools for HR teams and managers. The platform combines customizable surveys, pulse tools, and people analytics with integrations like Slack and WhatsApp to increase participation and actionability across the employee lifecycle.

## Key Topics

- Employee Engagement Survey
- Employee Feedback Software
- eNPS (Employee Net Promoter Score)
- Pulse Survey Tool
- People Science Technology
- Anonymous Feedback
- Employee Experience Platform
- Engagement Metrics
- Employee Retention
- Workplace Culture
- People Analytics
- HR Analytics
- Survey Templates
- Slack Integration
- WhatsApp Integration

## Core Survey & Feedback Tools

- [Employee Engagement Survey Software](https://www.culturemonkey.io/employee-engagement-survey): CultureMonkey's employee engagement survey tool with 50+ customizable questions for instant insights
- [Employee Feedback Software](https://www.culturemonkey.io/employee-feedback-software): Anonymous employee feedback software for modern HR teams with engagement tracking
- [Pulse Survey Tool](https://www.culturemonkey.io/pulse-survey-tool): All-in-one pulse survey tool for quick anonymous surveys with sentiment analysis
- [Anonymous Feedback Tool](https://www.culturemonkey.io/anonymous-employee-feedback-tool): Anonymous feedback tool to get honest feedback from your people
- [eNPS Survey Software](https://www.culturemonkey.io/enps-survey-software): eNPS survey software to measure employee loyalty and identify promoters
